act.name: Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act, 1956
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing Hindu adoption and maintenance of spouses, children and aged parents.

sections.title: Requisites of a valid adoption.
sections.text: Section 6 lists the statutory requirements for a valid adoption under the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: An adoption is valid only when the adopting person, giving person, child and procedure satisfy the Act.

sections.title: Maintenance of wife.
sections.text: Section 18 recognizes a Hindu wife's right to maintenance from her husband subject to the statutory conditions.
sections.plain_language_summary: A Hindu wife may claim maintenance from her husband in circumstances covered by the Act.

sections.title: Maintenance of children and aged parents.
sections.text: Section 20 governs maintenance obligations toward children and aged or infirm parents.
sections.plain_language_summary: A person may have a statutory duty to maintain children and aged or infirm parents.
